# Healthcare Administrators

This folder catalogs individuals who hold administrative, coordinating, or representative roles within the healthcare quality and clinical database governance structures documented in the corpus. It includes head nurses and data controller representatives who serve as primary contact persons for regional clinical quality development programs and national quality institutes, alongside patient representatives appointed to steering committees. The pages detail each person's specific institutional affiliations, committee memberships, and official contact responsibilities, with all claims traced back to the original annual database reports.

## Pages

- [[birgitte-ruhmann|Birgitte Rühmann]] — Head nurse and data controller representative acting as a primary contact person for RKKP and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, and a member of the acute surgery database steering committee.
- [[vera-slyk|Vera Slyk]] — Patient representative serving as a member of the steering committee for the acute surgery database.
